definitions: Relating to or characteristic of the Mafia, a hierarchically structured secret organization allegedly engaged in smuggling, racketeering, and other criminal activities.
Resembling the Mafia in terms of secrecy, control, or criminal activity.
examples: The police investigated the mafia connections of the businessman.
He was involved in a mafia-style protection racket.
The company had a mafia-like grip on the industry.
